title: OpenBrick3D calibration coupon sweep
description: The calibration coupon sweep (standards/coupon-*.json, kind coupon): one cell per swept dimension with its range, step, nominal and the fit offset it calibrates. Read by openbrick-print as CouponSpec (openbrick_print::coupon_v1()); the coupon generator, openbrick calibrate record and validator rule CLUTCH.RISK use the same numbers. See docs/plan/05 section 4. A 1.0 document may use only the fields named here ($defs/knownFields).

version.description: Coupon layout version, written into a fit profile as calibration.couponVersion. A changed sweep is a new version and a new file.

notes.description: Free text. Not read by openbrick-print.

source.description: Where the layout numbers (copies, label) come from. Required: every geometry number cites its source (CLAUDE.md).

copies.description: How many identical rows of every sweep the coupon prints, for repeatability.

label.description: The embossed label on each cell.

reliefMm.description: Relief height of the label in millimetres.

strokeMm.description: Stroke width of the label in millimetres.

cells.description: The sweeps, in the order the coupon prints them. Ids must be unique, every standardId must name a row of the Dimensional Standard with a nominal, and endMm must lie a whole number of steps after startMm; JSON Schema cannot say so, so openbrick-print checks it when it loads the file (CouponSpec::check), and cargo xtask data runs that check.

knownFields.description: The fields schema 1.0 names, object by object; true means the value is checked by the main schema. Applied only to 1.0 documents (see atThisMinor), where any other field is an error: serde would drop it silently, so a misspelt optional field would change nothing. Objects not listed here are open on purpose. cargo xtask data checks that these lists match the properties the schema declares.

atThisMinor.description: Matches a document whose pragma names this schema's minor version, 1.0 (or a 1.0.x patch). Such a document may use only the fields this schema names ($defs/knownFields). A document of a later 1.x minor may carry fields added since; this schema checks the fields it knows and ignores the rest, so older tools can still read newer minors (docs/plan/08 section 9).

cell.description: One swept dimension (openbrick_print::CouponCell). Its values are startMm + i x stepMm for every whole i up to endMm; the chosen value minus the nominal of standardId is the fit offset named by offsetField.

id.description: Cell id: the key of calibration.chosenCells in a fit profile and of required_cells() (stud, tube, pocketTubeOD, ...).

label.description: What the cell sweeps, for people.

row.description: Coupon row the cell is printed in; cells that share a row are printed together.

standardId.description: Id of the row of standards/dimensions-v1.json that gives the nominal.

startMm.description: First value of the sweep in millimetres.

endMm.description: Last value of the sweep in millimetres, a whole number of steps after startMm.

stepMm.description: Step between neighbouring cells in millimetres.

offsetField.description: The offsetsMm field of a fit profile this cell calibrates, or null for a row printed for reference only (openbrick calibrate record refuses it).

source.description: Where the sweep comes from. Required: every geometry number cites its source (CLAUDE.md).

positiveMm.description: A length in millimetres greater than zero.

pragma.description: Schema version pragma: major 1 and a minor, optionally a patch (docs/plan/08 sections 1 and 9). Every 1.x is accepted: readers ignore fields from minors newer than they know, and this schema checks only the fields it names in documents newer than 1.0 (see atThisMinor).

spdx.description: An SPDX licence id, or a simple AND, OR or WITH expression of ids (LICENSE-POLICY.md).

credit.description: Who made the document. Keeping it is a community norm, not a legal condition (LICENSE-POLICY.md).

provenance.description: Where the data came from, so attribution travels with it through conversion, export and printing (LICENSE-POLICY.md, docs/plan/06 section 2).

source.description: original, or the upstream file or project the data derives from.
